transcript: Speaker A: Interview mein haar kaise pakki karein? [How to ensure defeat in an interview?] Pehla, bina taiyari ke interview mat do. Job description dekho. [First, don't go to an interview without preparation. Look at the job description.] Kya skills maang rahe hain, kya question aate hain, kaisi English chahiye. [See what skills they want, what questions are asked, and what kind of English is needed.] Doosra, favourite vocabulary ratta mat lagao. Simple aur clear English bolo jo HR samjhe. [Second, don't rote-learn fancy vocabulary. Speak simple and clear English that the HR understands.] Teesra, internet se 'Tell me about yourself' ka answer copy karna band karo. [Third, stop copying 'Tell me about yourself' answers from the internet.] Chautha, interview se do minute pehle taiyari mat karo. [Fourth, don't prepare just two minutes before the interview.] Paanchwa, English sirf samajhna band karo aur bolna shuru karo. AI coach se practice karo. [Fifth, stop just understanding English and start speaking it. Practice with an AI coach.] Agar inme se koi bhi teen aadatein hain toh mubarak ho, tum hamesha rejection paoge. [If you have any three of these habits, congratulations, you will always get rejected.] Par abhi bhi der nahi hui hai. English Seekho app download karo, trial sirf ek rupee ka hai. [But it's not too late. Download the English Seekho app, the trial is just 1 rupee.] Spoken English Mastery course kholo. AI coach 24 ghante available hai. [Open the Spoken English Mastery course. The AI coach is available 24/7.] Toh aaj se yeh paanch galtiyan band karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So stop these five mistakes today and download the English Seekho app.] Voiceover: Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
